name: Amarube Tooru
source:
3rd year high school student.
A mysterious guy who suddenly invites the protagonist to join the astronomy club.
He's the president of the astronomy club and its only member.
A vague guy who is always popping up in unexpected places, he's not very good at communicating but he isn't a bad guy.
